name: Interior Drywall Ceiling RP Prep
intent: Condition-driven prep: wash/clean, sand/scuff (sound) or scrape (failing), fill/patch, dust cleanup. Overhead penalty ~80% of wall rates.
doctrine: Condition-driven prep with overhead penalty (~80% of wall rates). Scraping at 65 SF/hr baseline with condition modifier. All rates at QT3 baseline.
